# = on text is exact
name = 'Ann Lee'

# = on text is case-sensitive
name = 'ann lee'

# != on a non-nullable text field
name != 'Ann Lee'

# CONTAINS on text is a case-insensitive substring match
name CONTAINS 'AN'

# EXCLUDES on text is its negation
name EXCLUDES 'a'

# A doubled quote is one quote
name = 'Dan O''Brien'

# CONTAINS finds a quote
name CONTAINS ''''

# LIKE wildcards are matched literally
name CONTAINS '%'

# ... and so is the underscore
name CONTAINS '_'

# A comma in scalar CONTAINS is literal; it does not split
name CONTAINS 'a,b'

# CONTAINS never matches NULL nicknames
nickname CONTAINS 'e'

# CONTAINS on a joined field
country CONTAINS 'an'

# = on a second joined field from the same join
country_code = 'JP'

# A leading space is kept, so nothing matches
nickname = ' Hana'
